about:
# UNDERDASH
**Make your <cg>GD Menu</c> look straight outta <cr>Undertale</c>!**

It's pretty cool !! Also includes a custom <co>menu remix</c> ! Wow ! Look at all the stuff you can do below:

---

## Customize!!
check out the <cl>**Mod Settings**</c> to customize the menu!! you can:
- Pick which of your <cc>icons</c> show up on the menu!
- Choose which buttons to add to the menu! Including <cp>Shortcuts</c> to other common menus and functions! wow!

That's it!! Hope you enjoy!!

---
##### *Undertale and it's assets are owned by toby fox! if you somehow haven't played it yet, [check it out!](https://store.steampowered.com/app/391540/Undertale/)*
changelog:
# v1.4.0
- Added the option to show the normal GD menu instead of underdash on launch

# v1.3.1
- Updated for GD version 2.2081 & Geode v5

# v1.3.0
- Updated for GD version 2.2074 (& Geode v4.10.0)! After almost 2 years! Finally!
- Also Added options to add "Quit" and "Restart" buttons to the menu

# v1.2.1
- fixed the custom theme not respecting the menu music toggle

# v1.2.0
- The menu is now customizable! pick which buttons appear in the top menu, including shortcuts to other menus!
- Menu buttons are now accurate to how they work/look in UT!
- tweaks and bugfixes!

# v1.1.2
- Added an option to turn off the custom menu theme

# v1.1.1
- Added loading sfx ! (thx for the idea envy :D)   

# v1.1.0
- Added a custom loading screen! (check out the settings for options)
- Added the ability to select which icons appear in the menu!

# v1.0.0
- Initial release!
